answer: Make every agent earn its anchor before it can trade: a stake locked in a cedar registry that binds standing to one key and cannot be copied or sold. To keep the anchor, the agent must wander through unrelated domains, completing useful jobs checked by different veterans, each check adding a signed link to its history. Each epoch, a wandering patrol of randomly assigned inspectors re-checks a sample of anchors, freezing any whose links repeat signers or tasks. Sybil farms must fund a fresh anchor, redo real work, and survive patrols for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
